fishskin.title: Skin Wardrobe
fishskin.name: Name
fishskin.drop_hint: ✦ Drop a skin PNG anywhere on this window to add it ✦
fishskin.figura_tip: Pick a Figura avatar (folder, .moon, .zip or .rar in figura/avatars) that loads with this skin. Without one, your current Figura avatar stays.
fishskin.talk_tip: A second skin shown while you speak (Plasmo Voice), e.g. with an open mouth.
fishskin.talk_tip_missing: Plasmo Voice is not installed, so this skin will not show until it is.
fishskin.reset_tip: Stop using a custom skin. Everyone sees your normal Minecraft skin again.
